items.title: What Should Costco Stock Holders Take From Its Fiscal Fourth Quarter?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) stock rose 2.9% in the first session after its Q4 FY2026 report. The shares trade at 46.4 times earnings, more than twice the S&P 500's 21.9, so holders are counting on growth that keeps coming. What should a Costco holder take from a quarter that beat estimates and lifted the stock, yet left questions about whether its price cuts are driving more sales.

items.title: Could Amazon Stock Survive AI Spending Outrunning Its Cash?
items.summary: Amazon now spends more on building its business than the business brings in as cash. On its July 2026 earnings call, management raised its 2026 spending plan to about $220 billion. Most of the prior $200 billion budget had been allocated toward AI and AWS. items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Turns Wellness Boutiques Into A Bigger Beauty Aisle Fight
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) is ramping up wellness-focused shop-in-shop concepts as beauty and self-care gain shelf space in big-box retail. Walmart is expanding its own beauty and wellness aisles with more premium brands, putting direct pressure on Ulta Beauty's core category mix. Retail partners and suppliers are increasingly treating wellness as a separate growth pillar, reshaping how Ulta Beauty positions its boutiques versus mass retailers.
